en: Vintage black‑and‑white Hungarian postcard. The picture side shows a street scene with historic buildings lining both sides and, at the far end, a church with a façade topped by a cross and a tall bell tower behind it. Below the image is bilingual printed text in Hungarian and German identifying the location. Handwritten Hungarian text fills the lower margin and top edge. The address side has the printed heading "Levelező‑lap.", a Hungarian postage stamp labeled "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA 4 FILLÉR", Budapest postmarks, and handwritten address details to Budapest.
